title: Milestone 3 · Enforce durable deadlines

columns.title: Know the hold deadline
columns.detail: Return a persisted expires_at value so the caller knows when the complete hold ends.

columns.title: Release abandoned seats
columns.detail: Make all seats of an unconfirmed, due reservation available to another booking.

columns.title: Downtime counts
columns.detail: A stopped process does not pause the deadline; expire due holds before accepting work.

columns.title: Deadline wins at equality
columns.detail: At now >= deadline, confirmation must fail. Eligibility is decided after obtaining the write lock.

columns.title: Completed bookings stay booked
columns.detail: Confirmation is final and retains every seat. Expiration must never release confirmed claims.

columns.title: Preserve earlier reservations
columns.today: Existing holds have no recorded deadline.
columns.detail: Assign one grace deadline at upgrade; retain IDs, selections, keys and terminal states.

columns.title: Replace containers safely
columns.detail: Keep the database on a named volume; replacing the service container retains reservations.

columns.title: A retry does not extend time
columns.today: Keys recover holds without a deadline.
columns.detail: Replay returns the original deadline and current state; it cannot renew or resurrect a hold.

columns.title: Host UTC clock
columns.detail: Provide absolute microseconds; the service samples it inside the acquired transaction.

columns.title: Reservation service
columns.detail: Expire due holds before every booking read or write, within the same transaction.

columns.title: Service startup
columns.detail: Migrate and expire before Uvicorn starts serving requests.

columns.title: Competing HTTP workers
columns.detail: Serialize booking reads too, because cleanup can write; sample time after lock acquisition.

columns.title: Movie Seats API
columns.detail: The same terminal clients use confirm, cancel, lookup and screening operations.

columns.title: Upgrade operator
columns.detail: Choose hold duration; first version-3 migration applies that duration once to existing held rows.

columns.title: Docker container + volume
columns.detail: Run one unprivileged service process; mount a retained local volume at /data.

columns.title: Booking client
columns.detail: Retain the request key and retry equivalent creation; completed outcomes remain observable.

columns.title: clock.py
columns.detail: Inject UTC microseconds for deterministic checks; format exact UTC timestamps for callers.

columns.title: db.py · operation
columns.today: Each operation opens its own transaction.
columns.detail: Acquire write lock, sample now, expire due rows, then run request work inside a savepoint.

columns.title: app.py
columns.detail: Configure hold duration using MOVIE_SEATS_HOLD_SECONDS (1–86400 seconds; default 300). Initialize before serving.

columns.title: db.py · complete
columns.detail: Clean up at transaction time before the lifecycle decision; an expired hold returns 409.

columns.title: domain.py · transition
columns.detail: Add terminal expired state; confirm and cancel of an expired hold reject without changing its reason.

columns.title: db.py · initialize
columns.detail: Add deadline column + due index; fill held rows once; commit version 3 with their timestamps.

columns.title: Dockerfile + compose.yaml
columns.detail: Pin Python/uv versions, sync the lockfile, run as nonroot and preserve /data on a named volume.

columns.title: db.py · hold
columns.detail: Expire first; preserve key lookup ordering; assign a deadline only for a new successful hold.

columns.title: expires_at
columns.today: Reservation has id, status and seats.
columns.detail: Add an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with microseconds; legacy terminal records may return null.

columns.title: Screening and lookup
columns.detail: Return effective availability and expired status; no caller needs to trigger a separate cleanup job.

columns.title: Startup readiness
columns.detail: Due holds are released before requests are accepted after a restart.

columns.title: Confirmation at deadline
columns.detail: 409 reservation_expired at equality or later, including a request that waited past its deadline.

columns.title: Repeated confirmation
columns.detail: Confirmed remains confirmed after its former hold deadline, and repeated confirmation succeeds.

columns.title: Upgrade response
columns.today: Old holds have no deadline field.
columns.detail: Existing held rows get one future deadline. Old confirmed/cancelled rows retain state and null deadline.

columns.title: Compose run + retained volume
columns.detail: docker compose up --build; replace container with the same volume and observe the same IDs.

columns.title: Expired keyed replay
columns.detail: 200 with the same expired reservation and original deadline; a new key is needed for another hold.

columns.title: Absolute deadline
columns.detail: Integer Unix microseconds, computed once as transaction time + duration. No in-memory countdown.

columns.title: Expired state and released claims
columns.detail: Change held -> expired and delete its claims atomically; keep original seats and request mappings.

columns.title: Original deadline after restart
columns.today: No time survives because none is stored.
columns.detail: Read the persisted timestamp. Restart, configuration change and replay never extend it.

columns.title: Expiry survives rejection
columns.today: Any domain error rolls back all work.
columns.detail: Commit due cleanup when an action rejects. Roll back only request changes to its savepoint.

columns.title: Confirmed claims
columns.detail: Only held rows are eligible for expiry; confirmed records and their claims are untouched.

columns.title: Version-3 upgrade
columns.detail: Preserve all data; give old held rows migration_time + duration exactly once; terminal deadlines remain null.

columns.title: Named data volume
columns.today: Database lives in the host checkout.
columns.detail: SQLite file is outside the replaceable image. Container deletion alone cannot erase the retained volume.

columns.title: Original retry binding
columns.detail: A key stays associated with its original reservation even after claims disappear.

columns.title: Exact time boundaries
columns.detail: At deadline−1 microsecond hold remains valid; at equality it expires; formatting round-trips exactly.

columns.title: Expiry and reallocation
columns.detail: Due A3+A4 become available together; a new hold succeeds; SQL failure cannot partially release claims.

columns.title: Stopped-service acceptance
columns.detail: Stop before A3+A4 deadline, wait past it, restart: old expires, new hold succeeds, confirmed seats remain.

columns.title: Waiting confirmation
columns.detail: Block confirm behind a real write lock; advance to deadline before release; confirmation returns 409.

columns.title: Confirmed preservation
columns.today: Confirmed is permanent without a clock.
columns.detail: Advance past the original deadline; confirmed seats remain claimed and replay stays confirmed.

columns.title: Upgrade and no renewal
columns.detail: Upgrade fresh v1/v2 fixtures; IDs and keys survive. Reopen with another duration: deadlines stay fixed.

columns.title: Container replacement
columns.detail: Remove container without its volume; replace after deadline; recover expired and confirmed reservations.

columns.title: Replay and rejection effects
columns.detail: Replay never renews time; failed confirmation still commits expiry; expired replay never reclaims seats.

nodes.title: Booking client
nodes.detail: Confirm the held reservation by ID, or read availability after downtime.

nodes.title: Movie Seats API
nodes.detail: Expose expires_at and expired results while retaining status/error conventions.

nodes.title: Host UTC clock
nodes.detail: Sample once after the write lock; now at deadline means the hold is due.

nodes.title: Reservation service
nodes.today: Reads state, then applies terminal action.
nodes.detail: Lock; expire due holds; savepoint; decide requested action. Preserve cleanup when domain work rejects.

nodes.title: SQLite engine / volume
nodes.detail: Also persist absolute deadlines. Commit expiry and claim release together; keep confirmed claims.

notes: ORDER · BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> sample UTC now -> release due held claims -> savepoint -> requested read/write -> commit.
AT DEADLINE · A confirm arriving at 04.900000 but executing at 05.000000 for a 05.000000 deadline returns 409 expired.
REJECTED WORK · Roll back only request work on a domain rejection, then commit expiry. SQL/infrastructure failures roll back the whole transaction.
UPGRADE · Existing held rows receive migration time + configured duration once. Reopening the same file never renews them.
REPLACEMENT · The container mounts /data from a named volume. Startup cleans due holds before serving; confirmed bookings keep their claims.

summary: Expiration follows persisted UTC time, not process uptime. The observed deadline is authoritative; volume retention preserves it across container replacement.
